storage: Cut off the leaves (keep them separately), store roots unwashed in the fridge crisper for up to 2 weeks; boiled beetroot keeps 3 to 4 days.
looksLike: A round, deep red-purple root 5 to 8 cm across with a smooth skin and leafy tops; the flesh is dark red and stains hands, boards and clothes.
howToPick: Firm, smooth, round roots with deep colour and fresh, unwilted tops if attached. Avoid soft, wrinkled or cracked roots.
shelfLife: 1 to 2 weeks in the fridge (general guidance, not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 25 g raw per serving (about 20 g boiled and peeled)

mergeNotes: Range 50.0–70.0 was wider than 30% of avg 60.0; narrowed to ±15%.
